summary: The rendered output captures the general layout and many core landowner/parcel details, but it has major issues in the top-right identification numbers, issuing authority wording, and missing placeholders for visible official stamp/signature elements. These prevent it from being a faithful digitization of the source.
matches_well: Main document structure is preserved: header, photograph/thumb impression area, landowner details box, parcel table, and bottom certification area are present.
The landowner name, address, husband’s name, father-in-law name, citizenship number, issued date, and issued office appear to largely match the source.
Photograph and thumb impressions are appropriately represented with bordered placeholders.
The parcel table layout and most visible parcel entries, transaction descriptions, plot numbers, land class, tenant names, and total area are generally represented.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows “जग्गाधनी संकेत नम्बर: PF002728503” at the top right and a separate number “NMO000091” below it. “NM0000095” does not match the visible source number, and the PF002728503 number is omitted.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Shows only “Land Ownership Certificate No.: NM0000095”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source header reads “भूमि व्यवस्था, सहकारी तथा गरिबी निवारण मन्त्रालय” and “भूमि व्यवस्थापन तथा अभिलेख विभाग”, i.e. different issuing authority wording than the rendered output.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Header reads “Ministry of Land Reform and Management” and “Department of Land Reform and Management”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source contains a prominent red round official seal/stamp overlapping the upper-left emblem/header area.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Only a coat-of-arms placeholder is shown and “(Official Stamp)” appears as small text under the office name; there is no bordered placeholder for the visible red round office seal.

discrepancies.location: far-right column of land parcel table
discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows a large red signature/mark in the far-right certification/signature column spanning the table rows.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The “Signature of the certifier” column is blank.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows “प्रिन्ट मिति: २०८२/०४/१४” without an “A.D.” calendar designation.
